scope: Fix tsup missing error in GitHub Packages with --ignore-scripts, resolve ENEEDAUTH / 2FA validation on npm, and complete v3.0.0-beta.1 release

tasks.title: Fix tsup not found in publish-github-packages job
tasks.description: In .github/workflows/publish.yml under publish-github-packages, append '--ignore-scripts' to the 'npm publish' command. Since build artifacts were already compiled in the build-and-test job, this bypasses the redundant 'prepublishOnly' lifecycle hook that failed looking for tsup.

tasks.title: Validate NPM Trusted Publisher & Fix ENEEDAUTH
tasks.description: Resolve the ENEEDAUTH error: (1) Reconfigure actions/setup-node with registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org' and supply NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}, (2) In npmjs.com package settings, enable automation token bypass for 2FA or execute a one-time local publish ('npm publish node-pptx-templater-3.0.0-beta.1.tgz --tag beta --access public') to permanently transition npm Trusted Publisher from 'Pending validation' to 'Active'.

tasks.title: Execute End-to-End Release Pipeline Verification
tasks.description: Trigger the release pipeline and confirm green checks across all 4 jobs: build-and-test, verify-package-managers, publish-github-packages, and publish-npm-registry. Update .agent/project_summary.md with the verified release status.
